title: Verify that a Site Content Editor can access the Media Center module and publish media items
description: Logged in as a user with the Site Content Editor role, verifies access to the Media Center module's Create/Edit Video and Album screens and the ability to publish.

steps.action: Log into Liferay CMS as a Site Content Editor
steps.expected: Login succeeds

steps.action: Navigate to the Media Center module
steps.expected: Media Center module is accessible

steps.action: Open Create Video screen
steps.expected: Create Video screen opens with all fields editable and a Publish action available

steps.action: Open Create Album screen
steps.expected: Create Album screen opens with all fields editable and a Publish action available

title: Verify that forced browsing to the Media Center admin edit screen is blocked for an unauthenticated user
description: Verifies that directly navigating to a Media Center Create/Edit Video URL without an authenticated admin session is blocked (redirected to login / access denied), rather than exposing the admin editor.

steps.action: Log out of any Liferay CMS session
steps.expected: No active admin session

steps.action: Directly navigate to the Media Center Create Video admin URL
steps.expected: Access is denied; user is redirected to the login page (or shown an access-denied message) and the Create Video editor is never rendered

title: Verify that publishing a video in the Media Center module makes it automatically appear on the Home Page Media Gallery
description: Site Content Editor creates a new video with all mandatory fields valid (Title EN = "Q3 Board Update", Title AR filled, Thumbnail = valid JPG, Embed URL = a valid YouTube link, Publication Date = today, Active = True) and publishes it.

steps.action: Log in as Site Content Editor and navigate to Media Center
steps.expected: Media Center accessible

steps.action: Create a new Video with valid Title EN/AR, Thumbnail, Embed URL, Publication Date, Active=True
steps.expected: All fields accepted, no validation errors

steps.action: Click Publish
steps.expected: A Liferay generic success toast is shown; video status becomes Published

steps.action: Navigate to the Home Page and check the Media Gallery section
steps.expected: The new video card appears in the Media Gallery section under All Media and Videos

title: Verify that publishing an album (with Flickr-imported photos) makes it automatically appear on the Home Page Media Gallery
description: Site Content Editor creates a new album with all mandatory fields valid (Title EN = "Annual Gala 2026", Title AR filled, cover Thumbnail = valid JPG, photos selected from an already Flickr-imported set, Publication Date = today, Active = True) and publishes it.

steps.action: Log in as Site Content Editor and navigate to Media Center
steps.expected: Media Center accessible

steps.action: Create a new Album with valid Title EN/AR, cover Thumbnail, photos from the Flickr-imported set, Publication Date, Active=True
steps.expected: All fields accepted, no validation errors

steps.action: Click Publish
steps.expected: A Liferay generic success toast is shown; album status becomes Published

steps.action: Navigate to the Home Page and check the Media Gallery section
steps.expected: The new album card appears in the Media Gallery section under All Media and Albums

title: Verify that a video/album saved as Draft does not appear on the Home Page Media Gallery
description: Site Content Editor creates a valid video and saves it as Draft (does not publish). Verifies it never surfaces on the Home Page.

steps.action: Log in as Site Content Editor and create a new Video with all valid fields
steps.expected: Video creation form accepts all fields

steps.action: Click Save as Draft (do not publish)
steps.expected: Video is saved with status Draft

steps.action: Navigate to the Home Page and check the Media Gallery section
steps.expected: The Draft video does not appear anywhere in the Media Gallery section, in any tab

title: Verify that deactivating (Active Status = False) a previously visible video removes it from the Home Page Media Gallery
description: A published video is currently visible in the Media Gallery. Admin edits it and sets Active Status = False, then saves. Verifies the video disappears from the section on the visitor's next page load.

steps.action: Confirm the target video currently appears in the Media Gallery section on the Home Page
steps.expected: Video card is visible before the change

steps.action: Log in as Site Content Editor, edit the video, set Active Status = False, and save
steps.expected: Active Status is saved as False; video remains Published

steps.action: Reload the Home Page and check the Media Gallery section
steps.expected: The video card no longer appears in any tab of the Media Gallery section

title: Verify that unpublishing a previously visible album removes it from the Home Page Media Gallery
description: A published album is currently visible in the Media Gallery. Admin unpublishes it. Verifies it disappears from the section.

steps.action: Confirm the target album currently appears in the Media Gallery section on the Home Page
steps.expected: Album card is visible before the change

steps.action: Log in as Site Content Editor and unpublish the album
steps.expected: Album status changes to Unpublished

steps.action: Reload the Home Page and check the Media Gallery section
steps.expected: The album card no longer appears in any tab of the Media Gallery section

title: Verify that album photos can only be managed through the Flickr-integrated import flow, not a generic upload control
description: Per project convention (Flickr is asset-import only, album management happens in Liferay after import), verifies the Album creation/edit screen in the Media Center module offers photo selection only from the already Flickr-imported Documents & Media set, with no generic "upload new photo file" control.

steps.action: Log in as Site Content Editor and open Create/Edit Album screen
steps.expected: Album screen opens

steps.action: Inspect the photo-selection control for the album
steps.expected: Photo selection presents only assets already imported from Flickr into Liferay Documents & Media (no raw drag-and-drop upload of new photo files for the album body)

steps.action: Attempt to locate any generic direct photo-file upload control on this screen
steps.expected: No generic photo-upload control is present on the Album form for adding new photos directly

title: Verify that Media Title (EN) cannot be left empty
description: Title AR is filled ("إطلاق الخدمات الرقمية لفرفة قطر"), Title EN is left blank. Verifies the save is blocked.

steps.action: Open Create Video screen
steps.expected: Create screen opens

steps.action: Leave Title EN empty; enter Title AR
steps.expected: Title EN field is empty; Title AR entered

steps.action: Fill remaining mandatory fields and click Save
steps.expected: Save is blocked with a validation error indicating Media Title (EN) is mandatory; item is not saved

title: Verify that Media Title (AR) cannot be left empty
description: Title EN is filled ("Qatar Chamber Digital Services Launch"), Title AR is left blank. Verifies the save is blocked.

steps.action: Open Create Video screen
steps.expected: Create screen opens

steps.action: Enter Title EN; leave Title AR empty
steps.expected: Title EN entered; Title AR field is empty

steps.action: Fill remaining mandatory fields and click Save
steps.expected: Save is blocked with a validation error indicating Media Title (AR) is mandatory; item is not saved

title: Verify that special/script-tag characters entered in Media Title (EN) are handled safely
description: Title EN entered as ``. Verifies the value is either rejected or safely escaped/sanitized, and does not execute or break the public-facing page rendering.

steps.action: Open Create Video screen
steps.expected: Create screen opens

steps.action: Enter `<script>alert(1)</script>` in Title EN
steps.expected: Script-tag string entered

steps.action: Fill remaining mandatory fields and click Save
steps.expected: Item either saves with the value safely HTML-escaped, or the save is blocked with a validation error

steps.action: If saved, view the item's card on the Home Page Media Gallery section
steps.expected: No script executes and the card title renders as plain, escaped text (no broken layout)

title: Verify that a video/album cannot be saved without a Thumbnail Image
description: All fields valid except Thumbnail Image is left empty. Verifies save is blocked (mandatory field).

steps.action: Open Create Video screen
steps.expected: Create screen opens

steps.action: Fill all mandatory fields except leave Thumbnail Image empty
steps.expected: All other fields valid; no thumbnail uploaded

steps.action: Click Save
steps.expected: Save is blocked with a validation error indicating Thumbnail Image is mandatory; item is not saved

title: Verify that an invalid file type is rejected for Thumbnail Image
description: A .pdf file is selected for upload as the Thumbnail Image. Verifies the upload is rejected with a file-type error.

steps.action: Open Create Video screen
steps.expected: Create screen opens

steps.action: Attempt to upload a .pdf file as Thumbnail Image
steps.expected: Upload is rejected with a file-type validation error ('Only JPG/PNG files are allowed')

steps.action: Click Save
steps.expected: Item is not saved with the .pdf file as thumbnail

title: Verify that a thumbnail file exceeding 2MB is rejected
description: A JPG file of 2.1MB is uploaded as Thumbnail Image. Verifies the upload is rejected with a max-size error.

steps.action: Open Create Video screen
steps.expected: Create screen opens

steps.action: Attempt to upload a 2.1MB JPG file as Thumbnail Image
steps.expected: Upload is rejected with a max-file-size validation error ('Maximum file size is 2MB')

steps.action: Click Save
steps.expected: Item is not saved with the oversized thumbnail

title: Verify that a Video item saves successfully when only a Video File is uploaded (no Embed URL)
description: For a Video-type item, only a Video File (valid .mp4, 20MB) is uploaded; Embed URL is left empty. Verifies the either/or requirement is satisfied and save succeeds.

steps.action: Open Create Video screen
steps.expected: Create screen opens

steps.action: Upload a valid .mp4 Video File; leave Embed URL empty
steps.expected: Video File uploads; Embed URL field remains empty

steps.action: Fill remaining mandatory fields and click Save
steps.expected: Item saves successfully — the either/or condition is satisfied by the file alone

title: Verify that a Video item saves successfully when only an Embed URL is provided (no Video File)
description: For a Video-type item, only an Embed URL (e.g. `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abc123`) is entered; Video File is left empty. Verifies the either/or requirement is satisfied and save succeeds.

steps.action: Open Create Video screen
steps.expected: Create screen opens

steps.action: Enter a valid Embed URL; leave Video File empty
steps.expected: Embed URL entered; no file uploaded

steps.action: Fill remaining mandatory fields and click Save
steps.expected: Item saves successfully — the either/or condition is satisfied by the URL alone

title: Verify that a Video item cannot be saved with neither Video File nor Embed URL provided
description: For a Video-type item, both Video File and Embed URL are left empty, all other fields valid. Verifies the conditional-mandatory rule blocks the save.

steps.action: Open Create Video screen
steps.expected: Create screen opens

steps.action: Leave both Video File and Embed URL empty
steps.expected: Both Video File and Embed URL remain empty

steps.action: Fill remaining mandatory fields and click Save
steps.expected: Save is blocked with a validation error indicating either a Video File or an Embed URL is required for Video-type items; item is not saved

title: Verify that the Video File/Embed URL field is not required for an Album-type item
description: For an Album-type item, no Video File/Embed URL is provided (and the control is not applicable to albums). Verifies the album saves successfully and the field is either hidden or not enforced as mandatory on the Album form.

steps.action: Open Create Album screen
steps.expected: Create Album screen opens

steps.action: Inspect the form for a Video File/Embed URL control
steps.expected: The Video File/Embed URL control is either absent from the Album form or present but not enforced as mandatory

steps.action: Fill all album-mandatory fields (title, thumbnail, Flickr-sourced photos, date, active status) and click Save
steps.expected: Album saves successfully with no validation error related to a video file or embed URL

title: Verify that a video/album cannot be saved without a Publication Date
description: All fields valid except Publication Date is left empty. Verifies save is blocked (mandatory field).

steps.action: Open Create Video screen
steps.expected: Create screen opens

steps.action: Leave Publication Date empty; fill all other mandatory fields
steps.expected: Publication Date left empty

steps.action: Click Save
steps.expected: Save is blocked with a validation error indicating Publication Date is mandatory; item is not saved

title: Verify that an item with Active Status = True but still in Draft/Pending Review does not appear in the Media Gallery
description: A video has Active Status = True but its workflow status is Draft (not yet Published). Verifies Active Status alone does not override the underlying publish-workflow requirement.

steps.action: Create a video with Active Status = True and save as Draft (do not publish)
steps.expected: Video saves as Draft with Active Status = True

steps.action: Navigate to the Home Page and check the Media Gallery section
steps.expected: The video does not appear in any tab of the Media Gallery section — both Published status AND Active=True are required together
